Which notifications can your agent read?
Choose, app by app, whose notifications it may read. The ones you leave off are ignored: your agent never even opens them.

If on, your agent also reads notifications from new apps and from apps without an icon (say, a bank you install tomorrow). If off, you pick them here whenever you like.
🔒 Your agent lives on this phone. It reads only the apps you turn on here; notifications from the rest are dropped unopened.
Step 2 of 2
Where does your agent reply?
Of the apps it reads, choose the ones where it answers your customers. It replies from the notification itself, just as you would.
Let it read this app first
We see no chat app on this phone. Install WhatsApp Business (or WhatsApp) and come back to Settings → Connected apps.
Your agent reads no chat app, so it cannot reply on any. Turn at least one on in the notifications it reads.
It can also reply on %1$s if you install them.
Wallets, banks and the other apps it reads offer no reply from the notification: there your agent only reads (to confirm a payment, for instance).
